turns.doctor_question: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?
turns.patient_response:
Hi, thank you. Well, what finally pushed me to make this appointment is that I'm having a really hard time keeping my focus at work. 

I can sit down to start an EPIC quality report, or go into a clinic metrics meeting with every intention of tracking what's going on. But... within just a few minutes, my mind has drifted so far that I end up rereading the exact same numbers over and over, or I suddenly realize I completely missed the whole point of the discussion. It's just becoming a real problem for me.

symptom_reasoning.S002: The patient explicitly describes an inability to sustain focus on tasks like reports and meetings, noting their mind drifts within minutes.

turns.patient_response: Well, it's been going on since my promotion. That was about two years and four months ago. I just found that having a larger portfolio of work started overwhelming the systems I used to rely on to keep myself on track.

symptom_reasoning.S002: The patient confirms the doctor's premise of having trouble keeping focus at work, stating it has been happening since a promotion over two years ago.
symptom_reasoning.S005: The patient describes how a larger portfolio of work overwhelmed the systems they used to keep on track, indicating difficulty organizing tasks.
